fusions.name: Sweeping Glare
fusions.desc: A glare through your visor that deals 4 damage to every enemy in a cone 3 tiles long, with a 30% chance to leave each [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Through the Visor
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: a bolt that deals 22 damage and ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Hold Their Gaze
fusions.desc: You lock eyes with up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles and draw them onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Flaw Finder
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour.
